citations.claim: cart exceeds track limit at first violating step
cart was still inside track one step before, showing drift outward
cart already far down-track 8 steps earlier with positive velocity

explanation: Controller with gains adapted to plant prioritizes pole upright (theta ~0.05 rad) over cart centering, applying small positive force ~1.2N in same direction as motion (v~1.38 m/s), allowing slow cart drift off the 2.4m track from initial offset theta=0.2, omega=0.5 under high gravity and coarse dt.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.406 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart drifts steadily to the far right end of the track while the pole remains nearly upright. By step 128 the cart is at the right boundary and shown as the violating body, with no pole fall visible.
